_about: Lux Automations — Stripe Payment Link slots for every own-site surface. STAGING ONLY — nothing here is live. Each slot holds the Payment Link URL created in the Stripe dashboard (Lux Automations account, payments + payouts verified active 2026-11-09). A null url means the link does not exist yet: the page renders the buy button in its honest 'opens December 1' state. NEVER put any API key (secret or publishable) in this file or anywhere in staging — Payment Links need no keys in page code.
_how: When a link is created in the dashboard, paste its https://buy.stripe.com/... URL into the matching slot, set status to LIVE-LINK-SET, and re-run ../verify.sh. See ../README.md and ../../stripe-everywhere-tap-list-2026-11-09.md.

crypto._note: CRYPTO RAIL — PUBLIC receive-only addresses from ~/workspace/user/wallet-addresses.md (Trust Wallet, collected 2026-10-31, verified character-by-character at collection; re-verified against that file by ../verify.sh on every run). An address can only receive — it cannot spend. No seed phrase or private key exists in any Lux file and none ever will. Addresses live ONLY in this config: never in page code, logs, or reports (reports use chain + last-4 only). STAGING ONLY — nothing renders on any live surface until Vance stamps it.

chains.assets: ETH, BNB, MATIC, and stablecoins (USDT / USDC) on any listed network
chains.networks: One address receives on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Avalanche, Optimism, zkSync, HashKey, Somnia, Arc

chains.disabled_reason: A Stellar account must hold a ~1 XLM reserve before it can receive anything; this account is not yet funded, so XLM is NOT offered as a payment option anywhere. Enable only after the reserve is funded and a test receipt is verified.

No XRP address on file yet — XRP is on the 'still to collect' list in ~/workspace/user/wallet-addresses.md (Vance's Oct 31 Trust Wallet setup). XRP is NOT offered as a payment option anywhere until it is enabled. Enable path, all three required, in order: (1) at a rested sitting Vance reads his XRP receive address out of his Trust Wallet and it is recorded in the wallet file after character-by-character read-back verification with him (sitting script in ../CRYPTO.md); (2) the account's base reserve is funded — per xrpl.org the XRP Ledger base reserve is 1 XRP (lowered from 10 XRP on 2024-12-02) and an account cannot receive before it holds that reserve, so until funded XRP has the same cannot-receive problem as XLM; (3) a small test receipt is verified on a public explorer — then flip enabled to true, mirroring the XLM path. Self-custody only: a payment to his own Trust Wallet address needs NO destination tag (tags exist for hosted/exchange accounts that share one address across customers — xrpl.org, Source and Destination Tags). The exchange-address-plus-tag route is rejected for this checkout: a buyer who forgets or mistypes the tag sends funds that cannot be matched to them.

confirmation.how: MANUAL / watch-based — unlike Stripe, no webhook auto-confirms a crypto payment. Buyer sends, then gives the desk: chain + amount + transaction hash. The desk checks the receiving address on a public block explorer; when the payment shows with enough confirmations AND matches the deal record (chain + exact amount + buyer identity/sender where visible), the desk marks it CONFIRMED and only then does work or delivery start (GET-PAID-FIRST, same as the card rail).

crypto.custom_deal_rule: Same law as the Stripe rail: 50% down starts the work; balance paid AND confirmed before the final files are released. Prices are fiat (CAD/USD); the desk agrees the exact crypto amount with the buyer in writing BEFORE they send (rate at payment time) and records it per stage — the buyer never guesses an amount.
